description: ACORD-inspired, illustrative base dictionary for the Document Gateway. Defines the shared entity types, their attributes, and the allowed relations between them. Schema recognition maps INTO this; extraction is constrained BY it; the assertion graph is typed AGAINST it; Genie/semantic definitions derive FROM it. Tenants extend it (see tenants/<t>/tenant.json dictionary_extensions). Not a verified ACORD extract — an indicative crosswalk.

Party.description: A person or organisation, and the roles it plays (insured, broker, insurer, coverholder, cedant, claimant). A party exists once; relationships are roles.

Insured.description: The party seeking or holding insurance coverage.

Broker.description: The intermediary arranging the insurance placement.

Insurer.description: The underwriter, carrier or syndicate providing coverage.

Coverage.description: A grant of cover within a policy, with its own terms.

Premium.description: The price charged for insurance coverage.

Claim.description: A demand for payment under a policy following a loss event.

Limit.description: The maximum amount payable under the policy or coverage.

Deductible.description: The amount the insured must bear before coverage applies.

Clause.description: A contractual clause included in the policy wording.

Exclusion.description: A specific peril or circumstance excluded from coverage.

RiskLocation.description: The location of the insured risk.

ISSUED_TO.description: The insured party on the policy.

PLACED_BY.description: The broker who placed the risk.

HAS_COVERAGE.description: A grant of cover within the policy.

HAS_PREMIUM.description: The premium charged for the policy.

HAS_LIMIT.description: Coverage limit attached to the policy.

HAS_CLAIM.description: A claim made against the policy.

CONTAINS_CLAUSE.description: A clause forming part of the policy wording.

EXCLUDES.description: A peril or circumstance excluded from coverage.

LOCATED_AT.description: The location of the insured risk.
